chunks: From him, from Ja'far, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I said to him: A man borrows something from another man after he has purchased it, and then gives it as a gift to him; is it valid for him? He said: 'Yes.'

key_terms.فَيَهَبُ: and then gives as a gift

ai.seo_question: Is it valid to borrow an item after buying it and then gift it to someone else in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on leases (*al-Ijarat*), this hadith clarifies the legal validity of a borrower returning an item to the owner and subsequently receiving it as a gift. Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms this practice, highlighting the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the transition between usufruct rights and full ownership transfer.
